text:
I'm with Clalit Rabinovitch in the Old North. It took them something like 3 months to figure it out but they finally did. 
If you go there, ask the relatively old lady with black hair on the 3rd desk. She only speaks Hebrew tho but she will know how because she went through it with us. 

I don't have temporary ID.  

We showed them the policy and had to come back a few times to insist. 

Good luck! 
Btw it's worth it now because I think I pay something like 50ils a month now, instead of like 500ils a month with tourism insurance.
